nodes.source_conclusion: MemXBall u₀ x H holds iff (1) for every u in [0,∞) with u ≤ u₀ the slice lift s ↦ H(u, s⁺) is C¹ (ContDiffOn of order 1) on [0,∞), with the derivative at s = 0 one-sided within [0,∞) ; (2) the map (u,r) ↦ ∂_r H(u,r), the derivative within [0,∞) at r of the lift s ↦ H(u⁺, s⁺), is continuous on the closed strip [0,u₀] × [0,∞); (3) for every u ≤ u₀ and every r ≥ 0, (1+r)³ abs(H(u,r)) + (1+r)⁴ abs(∂_r H(u,r)) ≤ x. Fields (1)-(2) are "continuous and posess a continuous partial derivative with respect to r" of (7.1) (continuity of H itself is the carrier's); field (3) is ‖H‖_X ≤ x for the printed sum norm (7.1) (U-NORMS), i.e. membership in "the closed ball of radius x₁ in the space X" of Lemma 1 with x₁ = x . No evolution equation and no ∂_u H are assumed

nodes.source_hypotheses: g C^n on t; f C^n on s; f maps s into t
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all g, f, s, t, n
nodes.source_conclusion: g ∘ f is C^n on s

nodes.title: Continuity of the within-derivative of a C^n function
nodes.source_hypotheses: f is C^n on s with 1 ≤ n; s has unique derivatives
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all f, s, n
nodes.source_conclusion: x ↦ derivWithin f s x is continuous on s

nodes.title: If f tends to v and u < v, then eventually u < f

nodes.source_quantifiers: for all l, f, u, v
nodes.source_conclusion: ∀ᶠ a in l, u < f a

nodes.title: Chain rule within sets
nodes.source_hypotheses: h₂ has the derivative h₂′ at h(x) within s′; h has the derivative h′ at x within s; h maps s into s′
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all h, h₂, h′, h₂′, x, s, s′
nodes.source_conclusion: h₂ ∘ h has the derivative h₂′ · h′ at x within s

nodes.title: A within-derivative transfers to a function equal on the set, at a point of the set
nodes.source_hypotheses: HasDerivWithinAt f f′ s x; f₁ = f on s; x ∈ s
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all f, f₁, f′, s, x
nodes.source_conclusion: HasDerivWithinAt f₁ f′ s x

nodes.title: The within-derivative value of a function with a within-derivative
nodes.source_hypotheses: f has the derivative f′ at x within s; s has a unique derivative at x
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all f, f′, s, x
nodes.source_conclusion: derivWithin f s x = f′

nodes.title: A function continuous on a compact set is bounded above on it
nodes.source_hypotheses: K compact; f continuous on K (order-closed codomain)
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all f, K
nodes.source_conclusion: BddAbove (f '' K)

nodes.title: Extreme value theorem: a function continuous on a nonempty compact set attains its maximum there
nodes.source_hypotheses: [ClosedIciTopology α]; s compact and nonempty; f continuous on s
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all s, f
nodes.source_conclusion: ∃ x ∈ s, IsMaxOn f s x

nodes.title: In a conditionally complete lattice, the least upper bound of a nonempty set is its sSup
nodes.source_hypotheses: IsLUB s a; s nonempty
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all s, a
nodes.source_conclusion: sSup s = a

nodes.title: Intermediate value theorem on a closed interval
nodes.source_hypotheses: a ≤ b; f continuous on [a,b] (order-topology codomain)
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all a, b, f

nodes.title: In a conditionally complete lattice a nonempty bounded set has its supremum as least upper bound
nodes.source_hypotheses: s nonempty and bounded above
nodes.source_quantifiers: for all s
nodes.source_conclusion: IsLUB s (sSup s)
